## Dashboard — v207

**File:** `dashboard/smart-camper-dashboard.yaml`

Header title line said v145; it now shows the current version. Comment-only, the dashboard is identical to v206.

v206 added a Power row under Current on each battery bank card (Energy tab).

**Install:** Paste the file into a new dashboard's raw configuration editor. Needs button-card, card-mod and apexcharts-card from HACS.

This tag marks the version at the public release (2026-11-18). Earlier versions were developed in a private repository; their changelog is in the file header and in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ysemenikhin/smart-camper-command-center/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
